intro.zh-TW: 使用邀請連結註冊 Bitfinex 帳號。
intro.en: Sign up for a Bitfinex account with this referral link.

description.zh-TW: Bitfinex 是讓使用者交易加密資產的交易所平台。這個邀請連結已經包含邀請碼 1dwvQlwCN；進入註冊頁後，若有推薦碼欄位而且是空的，請自行填入這組代碼。註冊前先看一下網址列，確認網域與 Bitfinex 官方網站一致，再填寫個人資料。帳號的申請條件與服務內容，請以 Bitfinex 官方網站的說明為準。
description.en:
Bitfinex is an exchange platform where users can trade crypto assets. The referral link on this page already contains the referral code 1dwvQlwCN. Once the sign-up page opens, check whether it has a referral code field; if the field is empty, type the code in yourself.

Before you enter any personal details, look at the address bar and confirm that the domain matches Bitfinex's official website. For account requirements and service details, refer to the information on Bitfinex's official website.

q.zh-TW: Bitfinex 邀請碼要輸入在哪裡？
q.en: Where do I enter the Bitfinex referral code?

a.zh-TW: 邀請碼 1dwvQlwCN 已包含在本頁的邀請連結中，請用連結開啟註冊頁。若註冊頁有推薦碼欄位而且是空的，就在該欄位填入 1dwvQlwCN。
a.en: The referral code 1dwvQlwCN is already part of the referral link on this page, so open the sign-up page through the link. If the page has a referral code field and it is empty, enter 1dwvQlwCN there.

q.zh-TW: 邀請碼無法使用怎麼辦？
q.en: What if the referral code is not accepted?

a.zh-TW: 先確認填入的是 1dwvQlwCN，並依原樣輸入（注意英文大小寫）；再確認網址列的網域與 Bitfinex 官方網站一致，然後重新從本頁的邀請連結進入。若仍然無法使用，請參考 Bitfinex 官方網站的說明。
a.en: Check that you entered 1dwvQlwCN exactly as shown, including upper and lower case. Then check that the domain in the address bar matches Bitfinex's official website, and open the sign-up page again from the referral link on this page. If it still does not work, refer to the information on Bitfinex's official website.
